title: The map of the effect: contours of D in the plane (N, m) for the torque and the load
caption: The size of the micropolar effect in the plane of the coupling number N = sqrt(K / (2 + K)) and of m = g / (2 l) (upper axis: K = kappa / mu); D is the relative change against the Newtonian fluid of viscosity mu_inf. Host only, no run. (a) Torque between the concentric cylinders of the chapter (R1 = 4 g, R2 = 5 g, w = 0 on both walls): contours D = 1 %, 5 % and 20 % of the exact solution (solid) and of the wall rule in its slip form (dashed). (b) Load of the bearing at an eccentricity ratio of 0.6 (R1 = 4 g, mean gap g, m built on the mean gap): the same contours from the film function of micropolar lubrication theory in the thin-film calculation (dash-dotted). Points: the runs of the chapter, in (a) the 15 places of the 19 rows of item 04, in (b) the 6 places of the 16 rows of item 09 (every place holds runs at the eccentricity ratios 0.3 and 0.6; the contours are those of 0.6). Shaded: D below the noise floor of the runs, 1.1e-05 for the torque (three lattices at g = 200 dx) and 3.6e-04 for the change of the load (three lattices at eps = 0.6, measured at g = 100 dx; no three-lattice set of the bearing exists at g = 200 dx). m at which D equals 1 %, 5 % and 20 %: K = 3 (N = 0.775): torque 30.4, 6.4, 1.8 (rule 30.4, 6.4, 1.9), load beyond the frame, 24.3, 5.6; K = 1 (N = 0.577): torque 20.3, 4.3, beyond the frame (rule 20.2, 4.2, 1.2), load 80.9, 15.6, 2.8; K = 0.5 (N = 0.447): torque 13.5, 2.8, beyond the frame (rule 13.5, 2.8, beyond the frame), load 53.4, 9.8, beyond the frame.
